lesson_scope: Integration of trigonometric functions to calculate definite bounded areas, splitting integrals across axis crossings, area between intersecting curves, trigonometric powers using double-angle identities, product-to-sum identities, integration by parts with trigonometric factors, revolution volumes, and gradient calculations.
